key_points: Q3 earnings beat with raised 2026 profit outlook, but stock sold off 3-4% on cash flow concerns and rising costs
CEO reiterated 'solid' demand environment for aerospace, supporting long-term thesis
Multiple headlines flag premium valuation and free cash flow conversion as near-term headwinds
Mixed analyst commentary: some see dip-buying opportunity, others view stock as fully valued
No structural thesis change; reaction reflects short-term margin/cash flow focus vs. long-term aerospace cycle strength
